title: 第7章 师父的秘密第8章 情愫
slug: 我在修仙世界成了香饽饽
content_zh:
杨欢本就是个行动力极强的人，一旦心中有了主意，便立刻着手制定实施计划。
他在脑海中反复推演着每个步骤，考虑着各种可能出现的情况以及应对之策，直到他觉得计划已相对周全，这才稍微放松下来。
躺在床上闭目养神，可思绪却依旧在那复杂的局势中徘徊，久久难以入眠。
第二天清晨，第一缕阳光还未完全驱散夜的凉意，一个道童便来到杨欢的住处，通知他师父云阳子已经苏醒。
杨欢听闻此言，瞬间精神一振，眼中闪过一丝惊喜，连忙起身整理好衣衫，打算先去探望师父。
杨欢对这位所谓的师父云阳子，谈不上有什么师徒情谊，毕竟他来到这个世界时日尚短，与云阳子还没有相处。
只是着眼于当下这复杂严峻的局势，再加上昨夜偷听到的那惊心动魄的消息——云阳子已被喂下七日散，命不久矣。
他清楚地意识到，云阳子此时的苏醒，哪怕只是短暂的回光返照，也至少能为自己后续即将实施的计划增添一分保障，多一丝周旋的余地。
于是，他便跟着那前来传唤的道童，脚步匆匆却又心怀忐忑地朝着云阳子的住处走去。
一路上，杨欢思索着待会儿见到师父以及其他人时该如何应对。
怎样才能从这看似平常的会面中获取对自己有利的信息。
同时又不露出丝毫破绽，以免引起他人的怀疑。
待他踏入师父的房间，这才发现，原来大师兄程锋、二师姐林汐以及师妹陆水瑶都已经早早地到了，唯独缺少了四师弟赵宇。
杨欢心里明白，四师弟恐怕是因为昨日炼丹房爆炸一事而受了伤，被大师兄和二师姐以照顾之名控制了起来。
至于具体的情况，他目前还无从知晓，只是隐隐觉得这其中必定有蹊跷。
当他的目光落在师父云阳子身上时，不禁微微一怔。
原本脑海中想象的师父应该是一位仙风道骨的长者形象，然而眼前的云阳子却完全超出了他的想象。
只见一个身材臃肿，至少重达二百斤的大胖子正慵懒地躺在床上。
那庞大的身躯几乎占据了整个床铺，面色苍白如纸，毫无一丝血色，双眼深陷，眼神空洞而又疲惫，嘴唇干裂起皮。
仿佛刚刚经历了一场大病，整个人看起来虚弱至极，毫无精气神。

此时，两个道童小心翼翼地将云阳子扶起，让他靠坐在床头。
杨欢赶忙收敛心神，与大家一同恭敬地向师父行礼。
云阳子缓缓地抬起那沉重而无力的手臂，像是用尽了全身的力气一般，轻轻地摆了摆，声音微弱且沙哑地说道：“罢了，罢了，你们都免礼吧。”
那声音仿佛是从喉咙深处艰难挤出来的，透着一股深深的疲惫与无力感，在这寂静的房间里回荡着，让人听了心生怜悯。
紧接着，云阳子的目光缓缓地从众人脸上扫过，最后落在杨欢和陆水瑶身上。
停留了片刻，眼神中似乎闪过一丝不易察觉的疑惑，随后便开口问道：“欢儿，瑶儿，你们此次在山下，在那清风镇究竟发生了什么事？
为何会遭遇如此变故？”
那目光紧紧地盯着杨欢和陆水瑶，仿佛想要从两人的脸上找到答案，眼神中透露出一丝关切与急切。
毕竟这关系到弟子们的安危以及宗门的声誉，即便自己如今身体虚弱，身为师父，他也不得不操心这些事情。
云阳子那沙哑的声音中，隐隐透着一股别样的怪异劲儿，在房间里回荡着，显得格外突兀。
杨欢凝神细听，心中不禁涌起一丝疑惑，总觉得这声音哪里不太对劲，怎么听起来师父的语气里竟带着些许娘娘腔的味道呢？
这突如其来的感觉让他有些摸不着头脑，下意识地皱了皱眉头。
不知为何，这声音在杨欢的耳中，莫名地让他联想起自己从前在那个世界里看电视时听到的太监的声音。
那种尖细、阴柔又带着几分拿捏的腔调，此刻竟与云阳子的声音奇妙地重合在了一起。
杨欢被自己这个荒诞的想法吓了一跳，不禁暗自思忖：“这怎么可能呢？难道自己的师父是个太监？”
这个念头刚一冒出来，他自己都觉得有些震惊，毕竟这实在是太过离奇，完全超出了他的想象范围。
此时，杨欢敏锐地察觉到云阳子的目光正在他和陆水瑶的身上游移，像是在探寻着什么答案。
他赶忙定了定神，强行将自己内心的疑惑压制下去，努力让自己的表情看起来镇定自若，然后开口说道：“师父，徒儿此次办事不利，实在是给师父和宗门丢脸了。”
他的声音中带着恰到好处的愧疚与自责，听起来倒也情真意切。
content_en:
Yang Huan is a very active person. Once he has an idea in his mind, he immediately starts to formulate an implementation plan.
He rehearsed each step in his mind, considering various possible situations and countermeasures, until he felt that the plan was relatively complete, and then he relaxed slightly.
Lying on the bed, I closed my eyes and rested my mind, but my thoughts were still wandering in the complicated situation, making it difficult to fall asleep for a long time.
Early the next morning, before the first ray of sunshine had completely dispelled the coolness of the night, a Taoist boy came to Yang Huan's residence and informed him that his master Yunyangzi had woken up.
After Yang Huan heard this, he instantly became energetic and a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes. He quickly got up and packed his clothes, planning to visit his master first.
Yang Huan could not say that he had any master-disciple relationship with this so-called master Yunyangzi. After all, he had only been in this world for a short time and he had not yet gotten along with Yunyangzi.
I just focused on the complicated and serious situation at the moment, plus the shocking news I overheard last night - Yunyangzi had been fed for seven days and was about to die soon.
He clearly realized that Yunyangzi's awakening at this time, even if it was just a brief flashback, would at least add a bit of security and a little more room for maneuver for his subsequent plans to be implemented.
So, he followed the Taoist boy who came to summon him, and walked towards Yunyangzi's residence in a hurry but with anxiety.
Along the way, Yang Huan thought about how to deal with the master and others later.
How can you get advantageous information from this seemingly ordinary meeting?
At the same time, he did not reveal any flaws to avoid arousing suspicion from others.
When he stepped into his master's room, he realized that senior brother Cheng Feng, second senior sister Lin tide and junior sister Lu Shuiyao had all arrived early, but fourth junior brother Zhao Yu was missing.
Yang Huan knew in his heart that the fourth junior brother was probably injured due to the explosion in the alchemy room yesterday, and was controlled by the senior brother and the second senior sister in the name of taking care of him.
As for the specific situation, he still has no way of knowing, but he vaguely feels that there must be something fishy in it.
When his eyes fell on his master Yunyangzi, he couldn't help but be slightly startled.
The master he originally imagined in his mind should be an image of an elder with immortal demeanor, but the Yunyangzi in front of him was completely beyond his imagination.
I saw a bloated man, weighing at least two hundred pounds, lying lazily on the bed.
The huge body almost occupied the entire bed. His face was as pale as paper, without a trace of blood, his eyes were sunken, hollow and tired, and his lips were chapped and peeled.
As if he had just experienced a serious illness, he looked extremely weak and lifeless.
At this time, the two Taoist boys carefully lifted Yunyangzi up and let him sit on the bedside.
Yang Huan quickly calmed down and saluted Master respectfully with everyone else.
Yunyangzi slowly raised his heavy and weak arm, swinging it gently as if he had exhausted all his strength, and said in a weak and hoarse voice: "That's it, that's all, you all can excuse yourself."
The voice seemed to be squeezed out from the depths of the throat, revealing a deep sense of exhaustion and powerlessness. It echoed in the silent room, making people feel pity after listening to it.
Immediately afterwards, Yunyangzi's eyes slowly swept across everyone's faces, and finally landed on Yang Huan and Lu Shuiyao.
After staying for a moment, a trace of imperceptible doubt seemed to flash in his eyes, and then he asked: "Huan'er, Yao'er, what exactly happened at the foot of the mountain in Qingfeng Town this time?
Why did such a change happen? "
The eyes were fixed on Yang Huan and Lu Shuiyao, as if they wanted to find the answer on their faces, with a trace of concern and eagerness in their eyes.
After all, this is related to the safety of the disciples and the reputation of the sect. Even if he is weak now, as a master, he has to worry about these things.
Yunyangzi’s hoarse voiceIn the middle, there was a different kind of weird energy, which echoed in the room and seemed particularly abrupt.
Yang Huan listened attentively, and couldn't help but feel a little doubt in her heart. She always felt that something was wrong with the voice. Why did it sound like there was a bit of effeminate tone in the master's tone?
This sudden feeling made him confused, and he frowned subconsciously.
For some reason, in Yang Huan's ears, this voice reminded him of the eunuch's voice he heard while watching TV in that world.
That high-pitched, feminine and somewhat controlled tone, at this moment, surprisingly overlapped with Yunyangzi's voice.
Yang Huan was startled by his absurd idea and couldn't help but think to himself: "How is this possible? Could it be that his master is a eunuch?"
As soon as this idea came up, he felt a little shocked. After all, it was too bizarre and completely beyond his imagination.
At this time, Yang Huan was keenly aware that Yun Yangzi's eyes were wandering on him and Lu Shuiyao, as if searching for some answer.
He quickly composed himself, suppressed the doubts in his heart, tried hard to keep his expression calm, and then said: "Master, my disciple did something wrong this time, which really brings shame to the master and the sect."
There was just the right amount of guilt and remorse in his voice, and he sounded sincere.
